title: Senior QA & Release Manager
description: Mission We are seeking an experienced Senior QA & Release Manager to provide enterprise-level quality and release leadership across Adecco technology initiatives. The role will define and govern testing strategy, coordinate release readiness across multiple programs, and ensure that business, product, engineering, vendor and operations teams have a clear, evidence-based view of quality risk before production deployment. The successful candidate will combine strategic governance with hands-on delivery oversight, build consistent quality standards, and develop strong QA and release-management capability across the organization. Responsibilities Own and evolve the end-to-end QA and release-management framework across multiple Adecco programs, products and platforms. Define testing strategies, quality gates, entry and exit criteria, release-readiness checkpoints, and sign-off governance aligned with business risk. Lead integrated planning and oversight across functional, system integration, end-to-end, regression, user acceptance, performance, security and production-validation activities, based on program needs. Coordinate release calendars, deployment dependencies, change readiness, go/no-go forums, production verification and post-release reviews. Provide independent quality assurance and challenge delivery teams where evidence, coverage, defect status or operational readiness does not support release approval. Establish consistent governance across internal teams and delivery partners, including clear roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, service expectations and quality controls. Partner with business, product, engineering, architecture, security, operations and vendor stakeholders to align quality priorities with business outcomes. Govern defect management, triage, root-cause analysis, leakage analysis and corrective actions, with transparent ownership through closure. Drive continuous improvement through risk-based testing, shift-left quality practices, reusable assets, automation, CI/CD controls and lessons learned. Oversee test environments, test data, tooling and resource demand, supporting effective planning, forecasting and cost-conscious delivery. Promote a quality-first culture in which quality is a shared responsibility across business and technology teams. Work Experience 8+ years of experience in software quality assurance, testing or release management, including at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership or management role. Proven experience leading QA and release delivery across multiple projects, products or enterprise programs. Strong knowledge of SDLC, STLC, Agile, Hybrid and DevOps delivery models, with practical experience applying risk-based quality governance. Experience defining test strategies, governance models, quality gates, release criteria and executive reporting. Demonstrated capability across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, user acceptance and non-functional testing. Experience coordinating complex releases involving multiple business units, systems, vendors, markets or deployment dependencies. Strong understanding of defect management, root-cause analysis, environment and test-data management, and production validation. Practical experience with test and delivery management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence or equivalent platforms. Experience managing external delivery partners, service expectations, escalations and quality outcomes. Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, decision-making and communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk to senior leadership. Ability to balance strategic direction with detailed delivery oversight and to remain effective in high-pressure release situations Good to Have Experience in a large, global or regulated enterprise environment. Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ERP, web, mobile, integration and data solutions. Experience shaping automation strategy using tools such as Playwright, Tosca, Selenium or similar frameworks. Understanding of CI/CD quality controls, API testing, cloud environments, observability and production-quality monitoring. Experience with performance, security, accessibility, data-quality or AI-enabled solution testing. Relevant certification such as ISTQB Test Manager, SAFe, ITIL, Scrum, DevOps or a recognized release-management qualification. Experience contributing to resource planning, financial forecasting, supplier governance or testing-tool strategy. Behaviour associated with success Strategic ownership with the ability to translate business risk into practical quality and release decisions. Credibility and confidence to challenge constructively, escalate evidence-based concerns and protect release integrity. Calm, structured decision-making under pressure, particularly during critical defects, deployment issues and go/no-go discussions. Inclusive leadership and cultural awareness when working across global teams, markets and external partners. Clear, concise communication with strong executive-reporting and stakeholder-influencing capability. Posting date: 02-11-2026

Job Description The Lead QA Automation will play a crucial role in shaping and executing the automated testing strategy for the organization and ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated testing solutions. This position demands a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of test automation frameworks, software development life cycle (SDLC), and a proven track record of successfully leading automation initiatives and and the ability to mentor and guide team members. You will be a key player in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of software releases while fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement an automation strategy aligned with overall testing and development goals. Design and develop a scalable and maintainable automation framework using Cypress. Oversee the implementation and integration of automation tools into the testing process. Lead the development of automated test scripts using Cypress for functional and regression. Review and provide guidance on coding practices to the automation team. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing. Collaborate with the QA team to develop test plans and strategies, including automation test coverage. Ensure test cases cover functional, integration, and regression testing scenarios. Investigate and report defects and collaborate with the development team to resolve issues. Lead and mentor a team of automation engineers, providing guidance and support. Effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and management. Participate in cross-functional meetings to discuss testing strategies and release planning. Provide training to team members on automation best practices. Maintain documentation on issues, resolutions, and improvements in the automation process. Ability to independently develop and execute automation scripts in Cypress Executes automated test scripts and report defects, ensuring that the product meets quality standards and adheres to defined requirements Work together with software developers to enhance and improve programs. Maintain updated knowledge of industry trends and advancements. Regular work on optimizing automation code quality and improving reliability indicators in the development process. Qualifications Required Skills 7+ years of experience as a Lead QA Automation Engineer, end-to-end quality driving and automation strategy. Strong coding expertise with ability to design scalable automation solutions. Strong hands-on experience in Playwright or Selenium for automation. Hands-on experience with Typescript for building structured, reusable frameworks. Deep understanding of API automation using Type script, including schema validation and integration testing. Excellent debugging and troubleshooting across UI, API, backend, and environments. Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Bamboo, GitHub Actions or similar tool Ability to write clean, testable, and maintainable code, and enforce coding standards across the team. Proven ability to optimize test execution, eliminate flaky tests, and improve automation reliability. Good understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipeline creation, version control, and environment configuration. Strong working knowledge of Jira for test planning, tracking, and reporting. Good understanding of cloud platforms like AWS or GCP for test execution, environment setup, and tooling integration. Familiarity with AI-assisted automation tools (self-healing tests, AI-driven script generation, Copilot) to accelerate productivity. Additional Skills Exposure to ETL/ELT testing is a plus Basic knowledge of OWASP Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) etc. Additional Information This job is open for Bangalore, Hyderabad, Noida, Pune locations.
